body:
Founder real-time, resolving SHANKPIT_OS_NORTHSTAR.md's shell-surface question via a concrete example: 'we do it with GFD GUI BATTLEGROUNDS' + 'SHANKPIT ADD A SECOND PAGE OF THE MENU FOR APPS.' New second lobby page, toggled via a dedicated button independent of the main grid. Launches DEADWEIGHT's real dw_gui binary as an unmodified child process (fork/execl POSIX, CreateProcess Windows) -- games' own interfaces stay completely unchanged, matching 'all of their interfaces will remain the same.' Found and fixed my own path bug (one extra '..') before shipping. Clean build, go test green. Live GL screenshot verification blocked by a confirmed pre-existing sandbox limitation (original binary also renders black here); verified the actually-new logic instead via a standalone harness that really executed dw_gui --version end to end. SHANKPIT d8024a4.

⚓ ☃
title: Apps page -- SHANKPIT lobby menu bundles other games as launchable entries
